+        elif line in ('logging console', 'logging persistence', 'logging enable rfc5424', 'logging on'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[1]
+            result.append(dict(dest=dest, name=None, udp_port=None,
+                               addr6=False, facility=None, level=None))
+        elif line in ('no logging console', 'no logging persistence', 'no logging enable rfc5424'):
+            dest = 'rfc5424' if line == 'no logging enable rfc5424' else line.split()[2]
+            result[:] = [item for item in result if item['dest'] != dest]
+    if buffered_seen or disabled:
+        # A disabled severity line describes an exception to the enabled set.
+        if not buffered_seen:
+            buffered.update(LEVELS)
+        buffered.difference_update(disabled)
+        result.append(dict(dest='buffered', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                           addr6=False, facility=None, level=buffered))
+    result.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                       addr6=False, facility=facility, level=None))
+    if not global_off:
+        result.append(dict(dest='on', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                           addr6=False, facility=None, level=None))
+    return result
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for item in want:
+        dest = item['dest']
+        state = item.get('state', 'present')
+        current = [entry for entry in have if entry['dest'] == dest]
+        if dest == 'facility':
+            existing = current[0]['facility'] if current else 'user'
+            if state == 'present' and existing != item['facility']:
+                commands.append('logging facility %s' % item['facility'])
+            elif state == 'absent' and existing != 'user' and existing == item['facility']:
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        elif dest == 'host':
+            matches = [entry for entry in current if entry['name'] == item['name'] and
+                       entry['addr6'] == item['addr6']]
+            exact = [entry for entry in matches if entry['udp_port'] == item['udp_port']]
+            prefix = 'logging host %s%s' % ('ipv6 ' if item['addr6'] else '', item['name'])
+            if state == 'present' and not (exact or (item['udp_port'] is None and matches)):
+                commands.append(prefix + (' udp-port %s' % item['udp_port'] if item['udp_port'] else ''))
+            elif state == 'absent':
+                for entry in (exact if item['udp_port'] is not None else matches):
+                    command = 'no ' + prefix
+                    if entry['udp_port'] is not None:
+                        command += ' udp-port %s' % entry['udp_port']
+                    commands.append(command)
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            existing = current[0]['level'] if current else set()
+            levels = item['level']
+            adds, removes = diff_in_list(levels, existing)
+            if state == 'present':
+                commands.extend('logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in adds)
+            else:
+                commands.extend('no logging buffered %s' % level for level in LEVELS if level in levels and level in existing)
+        else:
+            command = 'logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'logging %s' % dest
+            present = bool(current)
+            if state == 'present' and not present:
+                commands.append(command)
+            elif state == 'absent' and present:
+                commands.append('no ' + command)
+    return commands
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=DESTINATIONS),
+        name=dict(type='str'), udp_port=dict(type='int'), facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='str', choices=LEVELS),
+        state=dict(type='str', choices=['present', 'absent'], default='present'))
+    aggregate_spec = {key: value.copy() for key, value in element_spec.items()}
+    aggregate_spec['state'].pop('default')
+    argument_spec = element_spec.copy()
+    argument_spec.update(
+        aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG'])))
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                      ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])])
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
